chunk.content: The value chain of island mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) in selected coastal municipalities around the Lagonoy Gulf, Philippines was analysed to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement.
chunk.source_quote: Analyzing the value chain of island mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) in the Lagonoy Gulf helps to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement.

source.title: Value Chain Analysis of Island Mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) in Selected Coastal Municipalities in Lagonoy Gulf, Philippines
